opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency opportunity through extraordinary claims of scale and personal earnings. The speaker calls it "The fastest company every tier at over a billion dollars in revenue, And the second-largest cryptocurrency in the world" and says that in less than two months he made more than twice his job income, presenting this as a major opportunity for friends and family. The supplied description provides a direct signup pathway, while the speaker urges viewers to "Take action and be a part of the evolution." These are active promotional claims and participation instructions, not criticism or investigation, establishing the opportunity being advanced.
